name: M5.SignatureCongruence.divisibility_of_quotient_eq
statement: ∀ (D a a' : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T : ℕ), D ∣ M5.cyclicModulus T → AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) a = AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) a' → (D ∣ a ↔ D ∣ a')
guidance: Use quotient equality to show cyclicModulus T divides a-a' via map_sub and AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero. Then D divides the difference, so divisibility is equivalent. Do not assume T positive: ideal/kernel argument holds even when cyclicModulus 0 is zero. Return tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.
